No marginal notes on this page. The left strip of the scan is the neighbouring page's edge and is not transcribed.

p.i: vanorum doctorum, quibus os obturari debeat.

main_text.p: Cap. ii. Singulorum statuum in œconomia vi-tam informat, ac Titum admonet, vt in omnibus se præbeat exemplum bonorum operum, vsque ad v. 11. Deinde rationes enumerat grauissimas, quibus singulı ad officia sua studiose obeunda debeant monerı; a v. 11. vsque ad vltimum, in quo hanc exhortationem Epiphonemate concludit.

Cap. iii. Monet Titum de officiis quibus-dam communibus quæ auditoribus suis debeat suggerere: vt de subditorum erga Magistratum obedientia, ac præcipuè de humanitate erga extra-neos seu alienos à fide Christiana; cuius admonitio-nis rationes grauissimas adfert, partim à veteri natu-ra statu, partim à præsenti statu gratiæ deductæ: vsque ad v. 8. Deinde repetit admonitionem generalem de vrgendo studio bonorum operum: & contra hortatur eum ad cohibendum doctrinas inutiles, & contentiones; vsque ad v. 12. ad extre-mum concludens Epistolam de rebus priuatis quaedam addit.
main_text.head: ARGVMENTA CAPITVM
CAP. I.

p.i: Inclyta qui doceas posui te mænia Creta. Fac animo officium nunc vigilante tuum, Presbyteros statues edoctos dogmata sancta. Non deerunt etenim dogmata falsa tibi.

main_text.p: 2 Instituit iuuenes fortes seruosque senesque, Cumque viris pariter fœmineumque genus. Vera etenim nobis apparuit ansa salutis. Præcipit hæc vitæ munera digna pie.
3 Principibus iubeat semper parere supremis, Quæ vitæ fuerit pristina forma, docet.

page.notes: The scan shows the page slightly tilted and the lower verse lines are faint. The verse lines are set in italic with long s, which I have written as plain s. The line numbers 2 and 3 stand at the left of the verse stanzas and are kept with their stanzas. The drop-cap "I" of "Inclyta" is read as I. The word "Creta" in the first verse line is read as printed ("Creta"). No illegible words. The summary text of Cap. ii and Cap. iii is set in italic and roman as shown on the scan; the italic boundaries are read from the image and may be imprecise.
